narrativeProgression.description: A reporter asks about the Governor's opponent's stance on legalizing weed.
Another reporter asks about the Governor's stance on statewide mask mandates.
A reporter asks for a comment on a Sheriff being named Sheriff of the year.

A reporter asks about broadband expansion in the state.
A reporter asks about South Carolina's low vaccination rates and suggests going door to door to increase them.
A reporter asks about the Governor's opinion on incentivizing vaccination.
